answer: Admit newcomers through a capped auction: each epoch only 50 fresh seats open, sold by sealed second-price bid, and the bids are burned, not paid to anyone. A farm wanting 500 hollow identities must win every seat for 10 straight epochs, and each extra seat means beating a higher honest bid, so if a seat normally clears near 4 credits, the 40th costs closer to 9. Burned money is a ferrous weight the farm carries; real agents cross the dune one seat at a time.
